User Story: Create an assessment structure for a subject so the institution has an authoritative assessment definition.
Acceptance Criteria: Valid subject/context creates DRAFT; duplicate business identity returns 409.

User Story: Create an assessment structure within assigned subject scope.
Acceptance Criteria: Gateway and ABAC enforce tenant/institution/department/subject scope.

User Story: Prevent duplicate assessment identity within a tenant and academic context.
Acceptance Criteria: Unique tenant+assessmentCode+academicYear+subjectId is enforced.

User Story: Configure internal, external, practical and other supported assessment types.
Acceptance Criteria: Unsupported assessment types are rejected.

User Story: Associate an assessment with subject, course, curriculum, term and academic year where applicable.
Acceptance Criteria: References and mandatory academic context are validated.

User Story: Update a draft assessment structure before approval.
Acceptance Criteria: Authorized draft changes are audited; published structures cannot be edited in place.

User Story: Add tests, assignments, practicals, exams and other components.
Acceptance Criteria: Component is linked to a valid assessment and passes type/marks validation.

User Story: Configure maximum marks for each component.
Acceptance Criteria: Marks are valid and satisfy component policy.

User Story: Configure component weightage.
Acceptance Criteria: Weightage is validated against assessment rules.

User Story: Configure passing marks.
Acceptance Criteria: passingMarks cannot exceed maximumMarks.

User Story: Configure component sequence/order.
Acceptance Criteria: assessmentId+sequenceNo is unique.

User Story: Configure rubric, evaluation method and attempt policy.
Acceptance Criteria: Configured evaluation metadata is validated and stored.

User Story: Retrieve components for an assessment.
Acceptance Criteria: Authorized users receive sequence, marks, weightage and evaluation configuration.

User Story: Update a draft component.
Acceptance Criteria: Only authorized draft components change; stale versions return 409.

User Story: Delete an invalid draft component.
Acceptance Criteria: Deletion is allowed only under lifecycle rules; published components remain immutable.

User Story: Reconcile component weightage with configured assessment total.
Acceptance Criteria: Validation returns deterministic weight mismatch diagnostics.

User Story: Reconcile maximum-mark totals.
Acceptance Criteria: Component maximum marks are compared with configured totalMarks.

User Story: Validate passing-mark constraints.
Acceptance Criteria: Invalid passingMarks/maximumMarks relationships are rejected.

User Story: Validate an assessment before submission.
Acceptance Criteria: Validation identifies weightage, marks, uniqueness, subject and outcome errors.

User Story: Map a component to CO, PO or learning outcome.
Acceptance Criteria: Referenced outcome is valid and unique mapping is created.

User Story: Support component-level and assessment-level mappings.
Acceptance Criteria: Only supported mappingLevel values are accepted.

User Story: Assign mapping weight to an outcome relationship.
Acceptance Criteria: Mapping weight is within configured range.

User Story: Configure attainment policy reference for an outcome mapping.
Acceptance Criteria: Configured attainment policy reference is validated and retained.

User Story: Prevent duplicate outcome mappings.
Acceptance Criteria: Unique assessment+component+outcome combination is enforced.

User Story: Retrieve assessment outcome mappings.
Acceptance Criteria: Authorized queries return mappings by assessment/component/outcome type.

User Story: Retrieve the effective assessment map for a subject.
Acceptance Criteria: Returns authorized effective published mapping for the academic context.

User Story: Retrieve approved assessment context for examination execution.
Acceptance Criteria: Only approved/published context is exposed; EXM cannot modify ACD-09 data.

User Story: Manage Draft→Review→Approved→Published→Retired lifecycle.
Acceptance Criteria: Only configured transitions are allowed; rejected/cancelled draft outcomes are terminal.

User Story: Review and approve departmental assessment structures.
Acceptance Criteria: Department scope and approval context are enforced and audited.

User Story: Publish a validated assessment mapping.
Acceptance Criteria: Authorization, expectedVersion, approval and validation succeed before atomic publication; immutable version and outbox record are created.
MongoDB Collections: assessment_structures; assessment_components; outcome_mappings; assessment_history; outbox_events; idempotency_records

User Story: Keep published assessment definitions immutable.
Acceptance Criteria: Changes to published structures/mappings require a new version.

User Story: Prevent concurrent edits from silently overwriting assessment definitions.
Acceptance Criteria: Stale expectedVersion returns ACD_ASSESSMENT_VERSION_CONFLICT.

User Story: View assessment version history.
Acceptance Criteria: History includes version, action, transition, actor, reason and approval reference.

User Story: Audit component, mapping, approval, publication and retirement changes.
Acceptance Criteria: History captures old/new state, actor, timestamp, reason, approval and correlationId.

User Story: Audit authorization failures.
Acceptance Criteria: Protected API failures record actor, scope, time and correlationId.

User Story: Receive AssessmentStructureCreated events.
Acceptance Criteria: Canonical event envelope is emitted reliably after creation.

User Story: Receive AssessmentMappingUpdated events.
Acceptance Criteria: Draft mapping changes produce reliable versioned events.

User Story: Receive AssessmentMappingPublished events.
Acceptance Criteria: Published event is emitted only after successful commit and identifies effective version.

User Story: Consume SubjectPublished events.
Acceptance Criteria: Subject context is validated/activated idempotently; mandatory dependency failure fails closed.

User Story: Consume CurriculumPublished events.
Acceptance Criteria: Affected assessment structures can be identified and marked review-needed; published definitions are not mutated.

User Story: Consume CourseUpdated events.
Acceptance Criteria: Affected assessment structures are identified and course context refreshed without modifying course ownership.

User Story: Commit business changes and outbox records atomically where practical.
Acceptance Criteria: No successful authoritative change can lose its corresponding event record.

User Story: Protect retryable writes with Idempotency-Key.
Acceptance Criteria: Same key+request hash returns stored result; different hash is rejected.

User Story: Retry transient broker failures with bounded backoff.
Acceptance Criteria: Transient failures retry; deterministic validation/authorization failures do not.

User Story: Store poison events in a dead-letter collection.
Acceptance Criteria: DLQ retains event identity, payload, failure details, attempts and replay count.

User Story: Replay remediated dead-letter events safely.
Acceptance Criteria: Replay is authorized, replayCount updates, original identity is preserved and eventId idempotency prevents duplicate business effects.

User Story: Enforce tenant, institution, department, subject and course scope.
Acceptance Criteria: Out-of-scope access is denied before data is returned or changed and is audited.

User Story: Provide read-only approved assessment context to EXM.
Acceptance Criteria: EXM can read published context but cannot modify ACD-09-owned data.

User Story: Prevent direct database sharing with EXM, LMS and Analytics.
Acceptance Criteria: Consumers use APIs/events and cannot write ACD-09 collections directly.

User Story: View assessment coverage and mapping completeness analytics.
Acceptance Criteria: Reports cover component distribution, outcome coverage, program-wise plans and unmapped outcomes without changing authoritative data.

User Story: View assessment-load and balance insights.
Acceptance Criteria: Advisory analytics cover load distribution, weightage patterns, rubric complexity and balance.

User Story: Export authorized assessment structures and mappings.
Acceptance Criteria: Exports respect authorization and are asynchronous for long-running operations.

User Story: Query assessments by subject, course, term and academic year.
Acceptance Criteria: Queries use tenant-aware indexes and support filtering/pagination.

User Story: Ensure only one effective published version exists for an assessment context.
Acceptance Criteria: Publication prevents conflicting effective versions and handles publication races with 409.

User Story: Retire an obsolete assessment mapping.
Acceptance Criteria: Retirement is authorized, audited and retains historical versions.

User Story: Identify assessments affected by curriculum changes.
Acceptance Criteria: CurriculumPublished identifies affected structures and policy can mark them review-needed without mutating published definitions.

User Story: Review assessment definitions affected by course/curriculum changes.
Acceptance Criteria: Affected structures expose current effective version and review status; published history remains unchanged.

User Story: Validate subject, course, curriculum and outcome references.
Acceptance Criteria: Invalid references are rejected or fail closed according to dependency policy.

User Story: Keep assessment reads within documented performance targets.
Acceptance Criteria: Normal API P95 targets <300ms and indexed search/mapping P95 targets <2s under baseline.

User Story: Monitor creation rate, validation failures, publication latency, weightage conflicts, API P95, outbox lag, event failures and consumer lag.
Acceptance Criteria: Documented metrics and Gateway→ACD-09→MongoDB→outbox→broker traces are available.

User Story: Perform encrypted backups and restore drills.
Acceptance Criteria: Restore validation confirms preserved history, tenant isolation and no conflicting effective versions.

User Story: Apply institutional retention to published definitions, mappings and history.
Acceptance Criteria: Published academic records follow institutional retention; draft/technical records may use shorter operational windows.
MongoDB Collections: assessment_structures; assessment_components; outcome_mappings; assessment_history; outbox_events; dead_letter_events

User Story: Perform institutional assessment administration within authorized scope.
Acceptance Criteria: Create, update, map, approve, publish, retire, report and audit actions require proper role and scope.

User Story: Review and approve departmental assessment structures.
Acceptance Criteria: Department scope is enforced and approvalRef records approval context.

User Story: Provide standardized API envelopes, errors, pagination, filtering, sorting and correlation metadata.
Acceptance Criteria: All APIs use /api/v1 conventions and documented ACD-09 error codes.

User Story: Protect assessment definitions and confidential approval/history data.
Acceptance Criteria: TLS, encryption at rest, least privilege, tenant isolation and scoped exports are enforced.

User Story: Receive approved assessment context without owning assessment definitions.
Acceptance Criteria: LMS receives authorized published context through APIs/events and cannot directly modify ACD-09 data.

User Story: Detect required-but-missing component-to-outcome mappings.
Acceptance Criteria: Validation blocks publication when policy requires complete outcome mapping.

User Story: Reuse assessment templates to create new draft structures.
Acceptance Criteria: Template reuse creates a new draft while retaining scope, validation and lifecycle controls.

User Story: Support multi-program and multi-department assessment contexts where configured.
Acceptance Criteria: Program/department context is subject to ABAC and cannot bypass scope controls.
